# Broad Street Pressure Wash

> Broad Street Pressure Wash is a Charleston, South Carolina pressure washing, soft washing, and window cleaning company. We serve homes, businesses, and property managers across Charleston and the surrounding Lowcountry.

## Location & Contact

- **City served:** Charleston, SC (and nearby Lowcountry communities)
- **Phone:** (843) 410-8934
- **Email:** broadstreetpressurewash@gmail.com
- **Hours:** Monday–Sunday, 9 AM – 5 PM
- **Website:** https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/broadstreetpressurewash/

## Service Area

Charleston, Mount Pleasant, North Charleston, James Island, Johns Island, Daniel Island, Summerville, Goose Creek, West Ashley, Folly Beach, Sullivan's Island, and Isle of Palms.

## Services

- **Pressure Washing & Power Washing** — High-pressure cleaning of hard surfaces: driveways, sidewalks, brick patios, concrete walls, dumpster pads. The terms "pressure washing" and "power washing" are used interchangeably in Charleston.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/services.html

- **House Soft Wash** — Low-pressure (under 100 PSI) cleaning of delicate exterior surfaces using a diluted sodium hypochlorite solution and surfactant: vinyl siding, painted trim, soffits, stucco. Algae and mildew are killed at the root rather than blasted off.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/soft-washing-charleston.html

- **Roof Cleaning** — Manufacturer-approved soft-wash method for asphalt shingles and metal roofs. Removes Gloeocapsa magma (the algae that causes black streaks), lichen, and moss without damaging shingles or voiding warranties. Most Charleston roofs need cleaning every 2–3 years; cost typically $400–$800.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/roof-cleaning-charleston.html

- **Driveway Cleaning** — Flat-deck rotary surface cleaner for even, no-zebra-stripe results on concrete, exposed aggregate, and brick paver driveways. Most Charleston driveways need cleaning once a year; cost typically $150–$400.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/driveway-cleaning-charleston.html

- **Gutter Cleaning** — Hand-removal of leaves, pine straw, and debris from gutter channels, plus downspout flushing and exterior gutter face brightening. Cleaning-only service — no installation or repair. Most Charleston homes need cleaning twice a year; cost typically $150–$350.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/gutter-cleaning-charleston.html

- **Exterior Window Cleaning** — Outside glass and frames, including upper floors via water-fed carbon-fiber pole. No ladders against fragile siding or trim.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/exterior-window-cleaning-charleston.html

- **Interior Window Cleaning** — Inside glass, sills, and tracks. Can be booked alone or paired with exterior in the same visit.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/interior-window-cleaning-charleston.html

- **Commercial Pressure Washing** — Storefronts, restaurants, offices, HOA buildings, shopping centers. After-hours scheduling available. Fully insured; Certificate of Insurance (COI) provided on request.
  https://broadstreetpressurewash.com/service_areas/charleston/commercial-pressure-washing-charleston.html

## Why Charleston Property Owners Choose Broad Street

- Single-location Charleston focus — not a national chain with rotating crews
- Pressure washing and soft washing both available; method matched to the surface
- Free walk-around quotes before any work begins
- Fully insured for residential and commercial work
- Window cleaning service in addition to pressure washing — one crew, one visit when it makes sense
